t: And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
